Proven track record of reducing API latency through Redis caching, automating CI/CD pipelines on Kubernetes/Jenkins, and architecting real-time platforms using WebSocket and Socket.IO. • Developed and maintained backend modules and enterprise application features, contributing to large-scale product roadmaps in an Agile environment. • Built and integrated RESTful APIs, handled database management (SQL), and resolved critical production issues improving system stability. • Participated in sprint planning, code reviews, and cross-team collaboration to deliver high-quality software on schedule. Tech Stack: JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, REST APIs, Git FEATURED PROJECTS RAG-Powered Document Intelligence API • Built a production-ready Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend API that ingests PDFs, web pages, and text documents, chunks and embeds them using OpenAI Embeddings, and stores vectors in Pinecone for semantic retrieval. • Integrated LangChain orchestration to manage prompt templates, retrieval chains, and context injection into GPT-4 / Claude completions, enabling accurate, grounded Q&A over private knowledge bases. • Designed a Node.js/Express REST API layer with streaming LLM responses (SSE), conversation memory using Redis, and multi-tenant document namespacing for enterprise use cases. • Implemented hybrid search combining BM25 keyword retrieval with dense

ses (SSE), conversation memory using Redis, and multi-tenant document namespacing for enterprise use cases. • Implemented hybrid search combining BM25 keyword retrieval with dense vector similarity scoring to maximize retrieval precision and recall. Technologies: Node.js, Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, Pinecone, Redis, PostgreSQL (pgvector), Express.js, Docker AI Agent Orchestration Backend • Developed a multi-agent AI backend using LangChain Agents and OpenAI Function Calling, capable of autonomously executing tasks like web search, code generation, database querying, and API calls based on natural language input. • Built a tool-use framework where agents dynamically select and chain backend tools (REST APIs, SQL queries, file I/O) with structured JSON output validation and retry logic for production reliability. • Exposed agent workflows via a REST API with streaming support, rate limiting, token-usage tracking, and audit logging for enterprise-grade deployments. Technologies: Node.js, LangChain, OpenAI API (Function Calling), Python, Redis, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS Lambda WebRTC Collaboration Platform • Built a Google Meet-like real-time video collaboration platform using WebRTC
